_README: Per-model API prices in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. EDIT THIS FILE to fix/add prices — keys are the model id (lowercased; any leading 'moonshotai/' is stripped automatically). Each entry: input = normal (uncached) input, cachedInput = cache-hit input (cheaper), cacheWrite = one-time cache-creation surcharge (Anthropic only; 0 for providers that don't charge it), output = generated tokens. A model NOT listed here shows a muted '$' whose tooltip tells you to add it. Local models are ignored entirely. CONFIDENCE: gpt-5.6-*, claude-fable-5, and dola-seed-2-1-turbo are from published prices; Claude opus/sonnet/haiku use the standard Anthropic structure (cached=0.1x input, cacheWrite=1.25x input) with generation-4 numbers; EVERYTHING ELSE (Kimi, Gemini, Grok, GLM, DeepSeek, Qwen, MiniMax, Cohere, MiMo, older GPT-5) is a ROUGH ESTIMATE — verify against each provider's pricing page and correct here.
_NOTE_gemini-3.7-flash: Introductory pricing $0.75/$3.75 (input/output per 1M) in effect through 2026-12-31; reverts to standard $1.50/$7.50 (same as 3.6 Flash) after that. Numbers below use the CURRENT introductory rate — revisit after the cutover date.
_NOTE_grok-4.6: xAI bills grok-4.6 on a CLIFF-EDGE threshold, not a blended/tiered rate: prompts under 200K tokens are $2/$0.50 cached/$6 output per 1M; the moment ANY part of a request crosses 200K tokens, the ENTIRE request rebills at $4/$1 cached/$12 output per 1M (500K context window total). This flat schema has no field for that — numbers below are the UNDER-200K rate, so any turn that crosses the threshold will show as under-priced here. Flagged for Lizard-kun rather than guessed at.
_NOTE_deepseek-v4-pro: As of 0813, 'deepseek-v4-pro' IS the V4-Pro-0813 GA build — DeepSeek updated the existing model id in place, no new UI id needed (confirmed via web search 2026-08-14: 'requests sent to deepseek-v4-pro now reach the 0813 build'). Numbers below are the flat pre-2026-08-16 rate. From 2026-08-16 16:00 UTC, DeepSeek switches to PEAK/OFF-PEAK pricing (peak 01:00-04:00 + 06:00-10:00 UTC): input rises to $1.32 (peak) / $0.66 (off-peak) from $0.435, output to $3.96 (peak) / $1.98 (off-peak) from $0.87. This flat schema has no time-of-day field — after the cutover this entry will underprice peak-hour calls. Revisit then.
_NOTE_qwen3.8-max: PUBLISHED prices (not an estimate). Model Studio lists input $2, output $6, implicit-cache hit $0.25, explicit-cache creation $2.50, explicit-cache hit $0.17. NEXUS never creates an explicit DashScope cache, so cachedInput uses the IMPLICIT hit price ($0.25) and cacheWrite is 0. If explicit caching is ever wired for DashScope, change these to 0.17 / 2.5.
